name: agent-presence
title: Agent presence
description: Shows which row or card an agent is editing right now: an edge in its colour and a small label, read out politely.

AgentPresenceRoot.description: Tracks the target and lays a box over it, the size of the target, for the outline and the label inside; speaks `announcement` from a polite status region. Other props, `ref` included, go to the layer (an absolutely positioned `div`, hidden from screen readers).

props.name: target
props.description: The element the agent is on: a ref, the element, or a selector. `null` hides the presence (it fades out).

props.name: state
props.description: `working` in the agent's tone, `done` green (then it fades out), `conflict` amber: a person edits the same target.

props.name: tone
props.description: The agent's tone while it works, the Badge hue pairs. Done is always green, conflict amber.

props.name: announcement
props.description: What screen readers hear, politely, each time it changes: "Satin is updating Tara Mendes".

props.name: doneDuration
props.description: How long `done` stays before it fades out, in ms; `Infinity` keeps it.

AgentPresenceOutline.description: The edge over the target, in the state's tone; dashed in a conflict. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `span`.

AgentPresenceLabel.description: The small label on the target's top edge, at its end corner: a small Badge in the state's tone. Put the mark and the words inside. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Badge.

AgentPresence.description: The outline and the label from props: the agent's mark and name while it works, a check and Done, or the person's avatar and "Jon Park is editing" in a conflict. Other props, `ref` included, go to the layer.

props.name: agent
props.description: Who is editing: a name, or AgentPicker's agent (its `tone` colours the presence; `avatar: 'flappy'` runs the bird).

props.name: label
props.description: The target's name, for screen readers: "Tara Mendes" makes "Satin is updating Tara Mendes".

props.name: person
props.description: For `conflict`: the person editing the same target.
